articles.title: EU opens MiCA consultation to review if crypto framework is still fit for purpose
articles.snippet: The European Commission is seeking feedback on whether the EU’s landmark crypto regulatory framework remains suitable as digital asset markets and global policies evolve.

articles.title: South Korean funeral company reveals $33 million loss on leveraged ether ETF bet
articles.snippet: A Seoul-based funeral services firm disclosed tens of millions of dollars in unrealized losses tied to leveraged ether ETF investments.

articles.title: Too many cooks: How regulatory infighting is choking the UK's crypto hub ambitions
articles.snippet: While the FCA opens its doors to market pilots, structural delays and legislative friction are fueling industry frustration over a framework trailing behind the U.S. and Europe.

articles.title: Germany's AllUnity plans Swedish krona stablecoin, pushes into AI agentic payments
articles.snippet: The DWS and Galaxy-backed firm targets June debut for its SEKAU stablecoin as Europe pushes to build regulated local-currency alternatives to U.S. dollar tokens.
